zh.prompt: 「他真是个勇敢的人」——什么样的行为才算真正的「勇敢」？
hints: 勇敢不是鲁莽，也不是懦弱
评估风险后的坚持，才是勇敢的核心
想想「明知山有虎」和「盲目送死」的区别
zh.explanation: 「勇敢」是个典型的歧义词：左端把它等同于鲁莽冲动，右端把谨慎等同于懦弱。真正的勇敢，是看清了风险之后仍然坚持做正确的事——理性的灰度地带。讨论「勇敢」前，先确认双方指的是哪种勇敢。

en.prompt: "He is a truly brave person" — what kind of behavior actually counts as "brave"?
hints: Bravery is neither recklessness nor cowardice
Persisting after assessing the risk is the core of bravery
Think of the difference between "knowing the tiger is there" and "blindly rushing in"
en.explanation: "Brave" is a classic ambiguous term: one end equates it with reckless impulse, the other equates caution with cowardice. Real bravery is persisting in doing what is right after clearly seeing the risk — the rational gray zone. Before debating "bravery", clarify which kind of bravery each side means.
